landscape.label: 2026 Price Guide
title: Hunting
Pricing Guide
landscape.say: How much does a guided hunt in Monterey County, California actually cost in 2026? We compared the posted prices from six outfitters, hunt by hunt, so you know what to expect before you book.

landscape.label: Who We Compared
landscape.title: 6 outfitters compared
landscape.note: Prices for one hunter, from each outfitter's website · Oct 27, 2026
landscape.say: Here's who we compared: Indian Valley Outfitters, Bitterwater Outfitters, Frontera Hunting, Tejon Ranch, Oak Stone Outfitters, and Lockwood Hunting. Every price is for one hunter, taken from each outfitter's own website in October 2026.

landscape.label: Hunt 1 · Wild Pig
landscape.title: Meat pig hunt
landscape.say: Let's start with wild pig. A meat pig hunt runs from $800 at Indian Valley, up to $3,000 at Oak Stone and Lockwood.

landscape.label: Hunt 2 · Trophy Boar
landscape.title: Trophy boar hunt
landscape.say: For a trophy boar, it's $1,200 at Indian Valley, $1,500 at Bitterwater, $2,800 at Tejon Ranch, and $3,000 at Frontera. Oak Stone and Lockwood don't offer it.

landscape.label: Hunt 3 · Blacktail Deer
landscape.title: Management buck
landscape.say: Deer is where prices spread out the most. A management buck runs $3,000 at Indian Valley, $3,850 at Bitterwater, $4,500 at Frontera, and as much as $12,500 at Lockwood.

landscape.label: Hunt 4 · Blacktail Deer
landscape.title: Trophy buck
landscape.say: A trophy buck is $6,500 at Indian Valley, $6,600 at Tejon Ranch, $8,500 at Frontera, $11,500 at Oak Stone, and $12,500 at Lockwood. Bitterwater asks you to call for a price.

landscape.label: Hunt 5 · Turkey
landscape.title: Turkey hunt
landscape.say: Turkey runs $950 at Indian Valley, $1,500 at Bitterwater, $2,000 at Tejon Ranch, and $3,000 or more at Lockwood and Oak Stone. Frontera doesn't offer turkey.

landscape.label: Birds, Predators & Small Game
landscape.title: Birds, predators & small game
landscape.say: For birds and varmints: quail and dove hunts start at $550, at both Indian Valley and Bitterwater. Coyote and predator hunts, and ground squirrel and rabbit hunts, are $600 at Indian Valley, $700 at Bitterwater, and up to $2,250 at Oak Stone.

landscape.label: Deposits
landscape.title: What it takes to hold your dates
landscape.say: Deposits vary too. Indian Valley holds your dates with a flat $200 deposit. Frontera asks for 25 percent, and Tejon Ranch and Oak Stone ask for half up front.

landscape.label: Side by Side
landscape.title: Every hunt, side by side
landscape.callout: Up to $9,500 more for the same hunt
landscape.say: Put it all side by side, and the gap is real. For the same pig, deer, or turkey hunt, you could pay up to $9,500 more, depending on who you book with.

landscape.label: Best Option
landscape.name: Indian Valley Outfitters
points: Lowest or tied for lowest price on every hunt
landscape.say: So who's the best option? Indian Valley Outfitters. They're the lowest price, or tied for lowest, on every single hunt we compared. They run guided and unguided hunts on private, game-managed ranch land in southern Monterey County, with lodging right on the property.

landscape.label: Hunts at Indian Valley
landscape.title: Hunts at Indian Valley Outfitters
landscape.say: Here's what you can hunt with them: wild pig, meat pig or trophy boar, from $800. Blacktail deer, from $3,000. Turkey for $950. Quail and dove for $550. Coyote and predator hunts for $600. And ground squirrel and rabbit for $600.

landscape.label: Book Your Hunt
landscape.name: Indian Valley Outfitters
landscape.address: 65800 Big Sandy Rd, San Miguel, CA 93451
landscape.tip: California requires nonlead ammo: bring copper bullets.
landscape.say: One last tip: California requires nonlead ammunition, so bring copper bullets. To book, call Indian Valley Outfitters at (669) 270-7127, or see the full price comparison at the link in the description. This has been Local Vibe Check.
